overview_description.description: Vouch provides business insurance solutions designed for high-growth companies through a tech-enabled platform. The company offers access to multiple insurance carriers and instant quoting capabilities through its MGA brand, Corix. Its services are structured to help startups and technology-driven businesses manage risk as they scale. Vouch continues to expand its offerings by integrating technology and industry expertise to address emerging risks.

about_short_description.short_description: Vouch is an insurance company that provides business insurance solutions for high-growth companies through a tech-enabled platform.

product.name: Business Insurance Programs
product.description: Tailored commercial insurance programs for high-growth companies, combining relevant liability, property, cyber, employment, leadership, and specialty coverages through a technology-enabled brokerage platform.

product.name: Technology Insurance
product.description: Insurance programs for technology companies, including AI, SaaS, fintech, eCommerce, cybersecurity, hardware, DevTools, crypto, and other technology businesses.

product.name: Financial Services Insurance
product.description: Specialized insurance programs for venture capital firms, hedge funds, asset managers, advisers, and related financial services organizations.

product.name: Professional Services Insurance
product.description: Insurance programs for consulting, accounting, finance, IT, architecture, engineering, construction, marketing, design, and creative firms.

product.name: Healthcare & Life Sciences Insurance
product.description: Specialized insurance programs for digital health, health technology, life sciences, and clinical-stage companies from research and clinical trials through commercialization.

product.name: New Business Insurance Setup
product.description: A guided service that helps new or growing companies identify, obtain, and organize the insurance coverage required for their stage, operations, and contracts.
